We at SEB are committed to accelerating the transition towards a sustainable and prosperous future for people, businesses and society. Through responsible advice and innovative financing and investment solutions, we support our customers on their transition journeys.

We believe companies that integrate environmental, social and governance aspects into their strategies are more successful long term, and SEB aims to be a leading catalyst in this shift.

SEB launched its first Green Bond Framework in 2016. It was expanded in 2022 to include more categories and align with the EU Taxonomy, and updated again in 2025. Guided by SEB’s sustainability policies, the framework ensures green bonds finance low-carbon and climate-resilient projects through green loans.

Green Bond Investor Reports

We publish a Green Bond Investor Report every year. It includes information on our issued green bonds, a description of how proceeds are allocated across categories of eligible green loans, and the impact achieved by the proceeds of outstanding green bonds.

Green Bond Framework

SEB’s Green Bond Framework, most recently updated in 2025, allows financing and refinancing in ten categories with the aim to contribute to the long-term vision of a low carbon and environmentally sustainable society. The framework is aligned with ICMA’s Green Bond Principles and is broadly aligned with the substantial contribution part of the EU Taxonomy. The framework has a Medium Shade of Green in the Second Party Opinion by S&P Global Ratings.
